description: Na₄PH₅Se₃O₁₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four SeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.63 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five SeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.75 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SeO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.58 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-54°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.60 Å. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.57 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.51 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.03 Å) and one longer (1.54 Å) H-O bond length. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.09 Å) and one longer (1.42 Å) H-O bond length. There are three inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-60°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.75 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-60°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.76 Å. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-64°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.70 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃Se tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom.
